content: Standard engram-field quantification: reactivation ratio = double-positive cells / total tagged(TRAP)+ cells. Chance-level overlap (used in optogenetic-reactivation / engram-overlap papers, e.g. Tonegawa/Josselyn-style designs) computed as (marker1+/DAPI+) x (marker2+/DAPI+) x DAPI+ count, then observed double+ count compared against this expected-by-chance count (commonly via chi-square or z-test) to claim above-chance overlap. This chance-level formula is the standard sanity check the field uses before claiming a real (non-random) engram/reactivation signal.
